children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - InMed Pharmaceuticals Inc.

"), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing a pipeline of proprietary small molecule drug candidates for diseases with high unmet medical needs, today announced that, pursuant to the previously announced agreement and plan of merger and reorganization dated May 19, 2026 (as amended, the "
"), it has fixed the close of business on November 5, 2026 (the "

The distribution of the CVRs is subject to and conditional upon the approval of shareholders of the Company at the annual general and special meeting of the Company scheduled to be held on November 4, 2026 (the "

") described in the Company's registration statement on Form S-4 that includes a proxy statement/prospectus of the Company and a management information circular, which was declared effective by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "
In connection with the Merger and pursuant to a contingent value rights agreement to be entered into on or prior to the closing date of the Merger (the "
"), InMed would issue to shareholders as of the CVR Distribution Record Date one CVR for each outstanding common share in the capital of the Company (each, a "

") held by such shareholder as of the CVR Distribution Record Date, with each CVR representing the right to receive contingent payments upon the occurrence of certain events set forth in, and subject to and in accordance with the terms of, the CVR Agreement. Investors who purchase Common Shares on Thursday, November 5 are not expected to be holders of record as of the CVR Distribution Record Date. Common Shares to be issued in connection with the surrender of outstanding in-the-money stock options of InMed, as contemplated pursuant to the Merger Agreement, will not entail any corresponding CVR entitlement.

Odyssey Transfer and Trust Company is acting as the rights agent for the CVRs. Shareholders holding their shares in book-entry form or in brokerage accounts need not take any action in connection with the issuance of CVRs. Beneficial holders are encouraged to contact their bank, broker or custodian with any procedural questions.

InMed Pharmaceuticals is a pharmaceutical company focused on developing a pipeline of proprietary small molecule drug candidates targeting the CB1/CB2 receptors. InMed's pipeline consists of three separate programs in the treatment of Alzheimer's, ocular and dermatological indications. For more information, visit
